en.headline: Government holds Chung Yeung ceremony at City Hall to honour wartime defenders
en.dek: Officials gathered at the Memorial Garden on Sunday morning for the annual rite commemorating those who died defending Hong Kong from 1941 to 1945.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government held its annual official ceremony at the City Hall Memorial Garden on Sunday to commemorate those who died in the defence of Hong Kong between 1941 and 1945.

The ceremony, which coincides with Chung Yeung Festival, included the playing of the national anthem, a flag-raising, a two-minute silence and the laying of wreaths by senior officials and representatives of veterans' groups, uniformed services and community organisations.

The Memorial Garden was built specifically for this purpose. The government has held the rite on Chung Yeung each year since the handover to honour those who sacrificed their lives and to encourage later generations to remember history and value peace.

zh.headline: 特區政府重陽節於大會堂舉行儀式悼念保衞香港捐軀人士
zh.dek: 官員及各界代表今早在大會堂紀念花園出席一年一度官方儀式，悼念1941至1945年間為保衞香港捐軀的人士。
body: 香港特別行政區政府於星期日在香港大會堂紀念花園舉行一年一度的官方紀念儀式，悼念1941至1945年間為保衞香港捐軀的人士。
儀式適逢重陽節舉行，包括奏唱國歌、升旗、兩分鐘默哀，以及由高層官員、退伍軍人團體、制服團隊及社區組織代表獻上花圈。
大會堂紀念花園專為相關紀念活動而建。政府自回歸以來每年重陽節均舉行此儀式，向捐軀者致意，並希望後人銘記歷史、珍惜和平。
